# Allergen Label Maker

> Free allergen matrix and draft pre-packed food (Natasha's Law) labels to check and print. Paste each dish's ingredients, get the 14 UK/EU allergens (or the US 9) per dish, and a label with allergens in bold. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). It reads the ingredient words a person types; it is a drafting aid, not legal advice, and a person must confirm every label against supplier information.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/allergen-label-maker/)

## How it works

- Word list for the 14 allergens (UK and EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II) and the 9 US major allergens, with look-alike exceptions (coconut milk, cocoa butter, butternut squash, rice flour).
- Foods that usually contain an allergen without naming it (hummus, Worcestershire sauce, pasta, dried apricots) are marked "check", never printed as a declaration.
- Supplier allergens can be stated in square brackets, `pesto [milk, tree nuts]`; that statement overrides guesses.
